nodes.label: Native LiteRT benchmark_model Runner
nodes.rationale: Official Google TFLite benchmark_model binary pushed to /data/local/tmp/ on device to profile inference latency and memory across CPU threads, OpenCL GPU, and Hexagon NNAPI.

nodes.label: SSD MobileNetV2 INT8 Defect Remediation
nodes.rationale: Quality audit uncovered counterfeit FP32 replica posing as INT8; resolved with true Coral uint8 quantized model achieving 5.93MB size and full NPU compatibility.

nodes.label: COCO Decoding and Multi-Class NMS
nodes.rationale: Decodes 90-class (SSD/EfficientDet) and 80-class (YOLO) outputs with BiFPN anchor variance scaling and Non-Maximum Suppression to filter redundant overlapping detections.

nodes.label: Aspect-Ratio Preserving Letterbox Preprocessing
nodes.rationale: Direct squash resizing to square inputs induces geometric distortion on non-square feeds, collapsing BiFPN anchor matches and yielding 0% detection; symmetric 114 gray letterbox padding preserves aspect ratio and anchor fidelity.

nodes.label: SPI Flash ROM 6MB Budget Gate
nodes.rationale: Smart cameras possess only 16MB to 32MB SPI Flash ROM; setting a strict <=6.0MB budget gate for models guarantees room for OS kernel, rootfs, video daemons, and ISP calibration.

nodes.label: Full INT8 Quantization Efficiency
nodes.rationale: Quantizing weights and activations to INT8 reduces model footprint by 70-75% and accelerates execution by 2.2x to 4.4x on SIMD/NPU hardware without notable accuracy degradation.
